Access our Mathematics & Statistics Journals during January!

It's January and it's Math Madness Month…. We're giving you free access to all current and back content of our Mathematics & Statistics Journals until 31st January!

For information about the promotion and a list of all the journals included, visit www.tandf.co.uk/journals/JanMathMadness

For any further information come and visit us at the Joint Mathematics Meetings 12-16th January in San Francisco at Booths 301, 303 & 305 or send an email to angela.d...@tandf.co.uk

Happy New Year!
